It's ticket **#8841**. Moss's 30 September strategic digest says Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group (VTG). Drivers on the second shift at the Newark facility couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk of the Pemberline Dock carrier portal.

The digest also says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue. I only read the digest, so I haven't confirmed the number against the ticket itself.
